   Successor Agency Agenda Report

Meeting Date:  February 6, 2024
From:  Jessica Alcaraz, Financial Services Administrator
Department:  Finance
Submitted by:  Angela Melgar, Finance Manager

Subject
Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule for the Period of July 1, 2024 through June 30, 2025

Recommendation
A. Receive and file the Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (ROPS) of the Successor
Agency of the Former Redevelopment Agency of the City of Vernon for the period July 1, 2024
through June 30, 2025; and
B. Authorize Successor Agency staff to provide any additional requested information to the Los
Angeles County Auditor-Controller and/or California Department of Finance to substantiate the
information contained in the ROPS and effectuate said schedule.

Background
Pursuant to Senate Bill 107, the Successor Agency must submit an annual Recognized
Obligation Payment Schedule by February 1st of each year to the Los Angeles County Auditor-
Controller and California Department of Finance. The attached ROPS for fiscal year July 1, 2024
through June 30, 2025 was submitted to and approved by the Los Angeles County Oversight
Board at its January 22, 2024 special meeting for the First District. Following review by the
Successor Agency, staff will submit the ROPS to the County Auditor-Controller, the State
Controller, and the California Department of Finance.

Fiscal Impact
The Successor Agency is requesting $4,273,408 in Redevelopment Property Tax Funds for its
enforceable obligation payments during Fiscal Year 2024-25.
